response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, but this role is explicitly for a Junior Java Developer entry-level position. He is drastically overqualified in seniority, his primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang rather than Java, and his German is listed as only 'Basic' against a role requiring strong verbal and written German communication for client-facing insurance consulting work.
strengths: Extensive, proven software engineering experience across many domains and technologies
Strong OOP fundamentals and familiarity with agile/TDD/CI-CD practices
Demonstrated ability to work directly with clients and lead technical initiatives
concerns: Massive seniority mismatch — Staff/Senior profile applying to an entry-level junior role
German proficiency listed as only 'Basic', falling short of the required strong communication skills
Minimal recent hands-on Java experience; current stack is TypeScript/Node.js, not Java-focused
